notes: All thirty-five reconstructed descriptions and critiques were read, including the fifty-seven retained valid first-repair leaves and the fourteen explicitly authorized exceptional replacements.

Every critique gives the particular move's contribution, limitation, live burden, and rating explanation; the four required labels remain but the rejected interchangeable sentence-bank language is absent.

The positive AI contribution develops a role-based explanatory test, a calibrated cumulative case, and a modal control comparison; the skeptical contribution distinguishes explanatory targets, kinds of underdetermination, and constraint without intervention.

Both AI sides were compared together: openings and paragraph progressions follow distinct inferential tasks, while the shared therefore in conclusions supplies ordinary logical parallelism rather than a swappable scaffold.

The complete AI section has normal punctuation, no provenance launchers within individual fields, and no shared normalized six-word sequence against either independent or recent twenty-five-debate window.
The source quotation audit remains exact, the cause-or-beginning question remains unchanged, and skeptical nonacceptance is not converted into proof of an uncaused or beginningless totality.
